name: GoGoVernier
description: Clean-room Vernier Go Direct (D2PIO) BLE driver for the GoGo Board 7 ESP32-C3 co-processor. NimBLE-backed, multi-device, full 32-channel support. Derived from VernierST/godirect-py and Vernier-Science-Education/GDXLib (BSD-3).
keywords: vernier, go direct, gdx, ble, nimble, esp32, gogoboard
